2586-4186-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat

728-1202-3249-6723.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1202-3249-6723.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

6258-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
6258-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-5470-7175-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-6794-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-3845.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1011-2438-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2438-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2438-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirror Image and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-7430--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat
2438-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

191-6625-7435.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-6625-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Repeat.

1181-4477-7182.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 4 once.
Resolve the evoke trigger from step 6, doing nothing.
Repeat from step 5.

1061-3499-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-3499-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-3499-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

997-2730-5987.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

1409-1652-2557.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

527-3499-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

4766-4825-5231-7091.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Emrakul, adding {R}.
When Emrakul dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Emrakul trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Emrakul and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
4766-4825-5231-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Emrakul or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Emrakul with the returned creature for that iteration.

328-2292-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2292-5220-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1062-3487-5437-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3487-5437-5674.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

3497-4484-4871-5643-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5643-6798.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5643-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3497-4484-4871-5643-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

183-2634-4036-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

618-2921-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

618-4050-4142.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1669-5478-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
1669-5478-5720-5721.description:
Activate Thaumatog's first ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

108-1308-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1640-5739.easyPrerequisites: Caduceus and Pariah's Shield are attached to the same creature.
1640-5739.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 30 or higher.
1640-5739.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah's Shield causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it is attached to.
Since Caduceus grants an ability to the creature preventing damage being dealt to it, no damage is dealt to you or to that creature.
1640-5739.notes: This effect will persist so long as you have 30 or more life.

1850-3561-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Swiftwater Cliffs from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Swiftwater Cliffs, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Swiftwater Cliffs trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-3968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-3968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

437-4067-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
437-4067-4474.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1563-1629-1651-1737-4321.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Gilded Pinions and a Food artifact token.
When the Gilded Pinions token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure and a Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Foods, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate the Gilded Pinions token and the Treasure token by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1512-1636-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster does not have summoning sickness.
1512-1636-4474.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
The Merfolk Wizard enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2580-3109-5141.description:
Cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Activate Lethal Vapors an arbitrarily large number of times.
Maintaining priority, cast Wipe Away by paying {1}{U}{U}, returning Lethal Vapors to your hand.
Cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}: until your next turn your life total can't change and you have protection from everything.
Allow all the activated abilities from Lethal Vapors to resolve, skipping an arbitrarily large number of turns.

2648-4050-5003.description:
Sacrifice Phyrexian Triniform to Phyrexian Altar to add {1} of any color.
Phyrexian Triniform and Nim Deathmantle both trigger.
Resolve Phyrexian Triniform's ability first, creating three Golem artifact creatures.
Sacrifice all three Geolems to Phyrexian Altar to add a total of 3 {1} of any color.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying the {4} to return Phyrexian Triniform to the battlefield with Nim Deathmantle equipped.
Repeat for infinite ETB and LTB.
